name: Otome ga Kanaderu Koi no Aria ~Kimi ni Sasageru Encore~
original_name: 乙女が奏でる恋のアリア ～君に捧げるアンコール～
source:
This is the fan disc for Otome ga Kanaderu Koi no Aria, featuring after stories for each of the 5 heroines and added heroine Kanade, while chara poll winner Kei will get a route as well. Two additional patches (for Mikoto and Kotori/Yuuhi) will also be available for download from their website for a month after the release.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/06/06/june-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《Otome ga Kanaderu Koi no Aria》的粉丝光盘，收录了5名女主角的后续故事，并添加了女主角Kanade，而Chara投票获胜者Kei也将获得一条路线。另外两个补丁（针对Mikoto和Kotori/Yuuhi）也将在发布后一个月内从他们的网站上提供下载。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/06/06/june-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
